content.title: THE NUTRIENT SHOWDOWN NOBODY {{EXPECTED}}
facts: **Avocado** has nearly **twice the potassium** of a **banana**, making it one of the richest plant sources of this mineral.
A single **Brazil nut** contains more **selenium** than several whole **eggs** combined — one nut can cover your entire daily need.
**Pumpkin seeds** pack more **zinc** per ounce than **cashews**, making them a quietly powerful immune-support snack.
**Walnuts** contain far more **omega-3 ALA** than **almonds**, which have almost none of this plant-based fat.
**Kale** has dramatically more **vitamin K** than **iceberg lettuce** — a single cup can exceed your daily requirement.
**White beans** carry nearly as much **iron** as **spinach**, without the oxalates that block some of spinach's iron absorption.
